correctness.rationale: Automorphism averaging preserves priced feasible set; the min-Rayleigh formula ensures concavity and no loss. Exact block eigenvectors give lambda_2=min(px,qx+py) for p,q>=2. An exact-rational standard-library verifier confirmed 720 eigen/cost cases and 72720 rational feasible points, not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The complete split graph is a canonical clique-with-periphery support; optimizing two independently priced edge families exposes a sharp, cost-independent-of-periphery critical ratio, loss or use of a whole graph edge orbit, and a continuum of optima at equality. For fixed q and cheap clique costs, gains relative to crossing-only investment approach p/q and are unbounded as p grows. This is a natural complete two-class price classification, not an unmotivated small case or routine parameter rename.
